title: Shadow Hearts: Covenant
subtitle: A curse during the Great War
summary: Shadow Hearts: Covenant is Nautilus's PlayStation 2 role-playing game, first released in Japan on 19 February 2004. body: Shadow Hearts: Covenant is Nautilus's PlayStation 2 role-playing game, first released in Japan on 19 February 2004. Set in 1915, it continues Yuri Hyuga's story as the First World War reaches the village he protects. German lieutenant Karin Koenig becomes involved in his struggle against a secret society, and a curse threatens the powers that once defined him. The adventure travels through an alternate Europe and Asia, combining historical surroundings with monsters, eccentric allies and supernatural plots. Its darker events share space with conspicuously comic episodes.

Four characters can take part in a turn-based battle. Their actions again depend on the Judgement Ring: the player times button presses as an indicator crosses the marked areas. Covenant expands the system with character combinations, allowing party members to link attacks into a longer sequence. Position and the order of actions become more important when building those chains. The timing mechanic keeps the player involved during an attack, while the party's different abilities provide the decisions that come before the button presses.

Yuri can still transform, while other companions bring their own unusual skills and personal side activities. Those differences make the travelling party a collection of people with distinct habits rather than interchangeable attackers. Returning director and writer Matsuzo Machida adjusted both tone and mechanics in response to the first game's reception. Miyako Kato returned as character artist, with music led by Yoshitaka Hirota alongside Yasunori Mitsuda and Kenji Ito. Critics particularly valued its characters and battle system, and the series continued with From the New World in 2005.
